description.value: Salmo Village Grocery is a 100% independent, family-owned grocery store that has served the Salmo community since 1982, positioning itself as 'where the village shops' in the hub of the west Kootenays. Part of the Coast Grocery Co. network, it stocks everyday groceries, seasonal produce, and deli meats. For touring cyclists passing through this part of the Kootenays, it offers a full resupply point in a small mountain town with limited alternatives.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at coastgrocery.ca/salmo confirms this is a real, operating grocery store at 303 Main Street, Salmo, BC with phone 250-357-2316, and describes grocery items, seasonal produce, and deli meats — supporting Basic groceries as true. No mention of bike parking, water refill, or most other cycling amenities appears anywhere in the website content. The OSM name includes 'on Main' while the website consistently uses just 'Salmo Village Grocery', flagged as a minor discrepancy.
concerns: OSM name is 'Salmo Village Grocery on Main' but the business website consistently uses 'Salmo Village Grocery' without 'on Main' — minor name discrepancy.
OSM has no address or phone; both were sourced from the website only, so contact_confirmed fields for address and phone cannot be cross-checked against OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, open, independent grocery store confirmed by an active website — an essential resupply stop for cyclists travelling through the west Kootenays.

Basic groceries.detail: Website states: 'Pick up all your favourite grocery items, seasonal produce, tasty deli meats and more.'
